title: Part Five: Always a Year Away: Netanyahu, 1984–2026

sections.brief: Netanyahu's US years: MIT, BCG, the Jonathan Institute and its 1979 and 1984 conferences, deputy chief of mission (1982-84), UN ambassador (1984-88), the 1986 book naming Iran among 'terrorist states'; an undated pre-1989 clip on 'a Gaddafi or Khomeini with nuclear weapons'; no dated Iran bomb estimate found before 1992. Figure: time

Every traceable dated statement on Iran's nuclear timeline 1992-2026 with words, date, venue and kind of claim: 1992 (reported), 1995 (wording disputed), 1996 Congress, 2002 (Iraq), 2009 cables, 2012 Meet the Press and UN, 2015 Congress, 2018 archive, 13 June 2025, 28 Feb 2026 (no date), June 2026 counterfactual. Figure: time

The fair test: dated estimates vs conditional thresholds vs undated warnings, scored against the 2007 NIE, IAEA 2015 assessment, the 2013 interim deal, the May-June 2025 stockpile and Board finding, Gabbard and Grossi 2025; Israel's delay argument (NIE on pressure, Dagan, Stuxnet, Netanyahu 2026) vs the crying-wolf critique (Intercept, Zarif, Cato, AP 2026).
